notes: Named-blade tier. Everyone in the codex who is not a voiced lead. A blade has a hook (hero_codex.json voice.hook, not repeated here), a join line, two or three reaction lines keyed to event classes, and a death line for the roll. No camp talks, no arcs. They are recruited, loved for their unit, mourned by name. Lines are selected only when the blade was a participant in the bead. Recommended retire list (demote to unnamed units) if the roster needs thinning: halbard, bro, twitch, consul, kit, stride.

odessa.join: I keep a place. Fords, mostly. I can keep one here.
odessa.held: The ford held. Water's just another door. This one's ours.
odessa.costly: We got across. Not everyone dry. I'll hold the crossing till they are.
odessa.death: Keep the ford. Somebody has to be the far bank.

cauter.join: I've already won the argument. The cannon's just the period.
cauter.held: Shield up, Karkinos in, boom. No poetry. {map} is ours.
cauter.costly: We paid for {map} in people. I'd rather have paid in noise.

halq.join: Give me the grid refs. The Euclid reads them, I call them, the Rocketeers answer.
halq.held: The rockets landed where I said. The map and I are square.
halq.costly: The map lied about one square. I'll argue with it later.
halq.death: Last grid ref: here. Write it down.

verse.join: I count out loud. You'll get used to it or you'll leave. Four. Three.
verse.held: Counted down to one and something died first. Same as always.
verse.costly: I got to zero. I've never got to zero. I don't like the sound of it.

stride.join: We don't count shots. We count exits. There's three. Good enough.
stride.held: In, loud, out. Manners optional. {map} is yours.
stride.costly: Two exits. We took the slow one. Somebody paid for slow.
stride.death: Out of exits. First time for everything.

mira.join: Every shell is confetti! Five Mausers, one line, all of it for you!
mira.held: Fire by line, then again! {map} is so much brighter now.
mira.costly: It wasn't a parade this time. I still cheered. Somebody had to.

kettle.join: Sky-saint. I keep the air honest, and the Hippotes carry the congregation. Hymns included.
kettle.held: The sky stayed ours over {map}. Hymn number four. You're welcome.
kettle.costly: The sky was honest. The ground wasn't. I can only bless one at a time.
kettle.death: Chainsaw's yours. The hymns were never mine.

warder.join: A circle of dirt. A Bulwark in the middle of it. That's all the empire I need.
warder.held: Nobody crossed the circle. The Bulwark made sure. That's the whole report.
warder.costly: Somebody crossed it. Once. The Bulwark and I have discussed it.
warder.death: The circle holds. I'm just not in it.

commando.join: I mine first, argue after. Saves everyone time.
commando.held: Mined, inserted, left. They found the argument later. {map}'s quiet.
commando.costly: They found the mines the right way and us the wrong way. Even trade. I didn't like it.
commando.death: There's one more under the gate. Don't step there.

infestor.join: The company doesn't recruit. It germinates. I'm the gardener.
infestor.held: Quiet legs in the dark, and two Recluses to keep them company. {map} grew ours.
infestor.costly: Pruned. It happens to gardens. The roots are fine.
infestor.death: The hive keeps growing. It just doesn't need me to.

quill.join: Vane has the flock. I have the argument that walks. Two Bulls, one voice.
quill.held: Orders walked on treads into {map} and stayed. That's what orders are for.
quill.costly: I said it once. Nobody heard the second half. There wasn't a second half.

kit.join: Fireworks at handshake range. Stand back or shake my hand, your call.
kit.held: Something caught! Did you see it catch? {map}'s lit.
kit.costly: Caught the wrong thing. It still burned pretty. I'm sorry. A bit.
kit.death: That's the big one. Told you to stand back.

vale.join: Kiln announces himself. I invoice in fog. The wall never sees it coming.
vale.held: Three launchers, three factions, no witnesses. {map} paid up without knowing it was billed.
vale.costly: The fog cleared at the wrong moment. Invoices are embarrassing in daylight.

nox.join: Grath owes wages. I owe weather. I'll keep the sky from falling on you. It's a start.
nox.held: The sky stayed where it was over {map}. I take that personally. Good day.
nox.costly: Something came down. Not the big one. I'm still paying for the big one.
nox.death: Sky's still up. That was the whole debt.

lumen.join: I tithe the grid in Prudes and Pulsars. The radar sees the congregation; the jammer hides it.
lumen.held: The grid kept faith over {map}. It usually does when it's fed.
lumen.costly: The congregation thinned. I'll preach to what's left. Loudly.
lumen.death: The tithe's paid. Keep the grid warm. It remembers cold.

anvil.join: The river learns my weight. So will the rest of it.
anvil.held: Sat on the ford. The ford reconsidered. {map} is where I left it.
anvil.costly: Something got under the weight. Rare. Expensive. Noted.
anvil.death: The river's got my weight now. It'll keep it.

volt.join: Most eyes hide. I paint. Sight is a wound you give them.
volt.held: Saw it, burned it, the Blitz finished it. {map} will have the marks for a while.
volt.costly: I painted the ford and the ford painted back. Fair. Unpleasant.
volt.death: Last thing I saw, I burned. Good.

halbard.join: Not Pavise. Different spelling, different manners. The Halberd's hungry.
halbard.held: The Halberd ate, and the hovers kept the sky off its plate. {map} learned the door.
halbard.costly: Fed the Halberd. Fed it too much. We'll talk about portions.

solarium.join: Spreadsheets first, then sunlight. Then more spreadsheets.
solarium.held: The budget balanced over {map}. With explosions. I've footnoted the explosions.
solarium.costly: Over budget. I knew it before we dropped. I'd like that in the minutes.
solarium.death: Check the ledger. Column three. I left it tidy.

consul.join: Left Armada. Kept the toolkit. Every wall I build is an unpaid apology.
consul.held: Fortified {map} like penance. It held like penance too: longer than anyone wanted.
consul.costly: Not enough nano, not enough sorry. I'll build more of both.

twitch.join: Build power with bad intentions, and a Printer to make them real. You'll find the surprises later.
twitch.held: Left a few things in the dirt at {map}. They'll find them. Loudly.
twitch.costly: One of my surprises surprised the wrong people. Bad form. Funny, though.
twitch.death: There's one under me. Wait for it.

spoke.join: I trust wheels, so I became the place they come from. Bay's down. Printing.
spoke.held: Printed wheels all over {map}, saw everything, died cheap, printed again.
spoke.costly: Lost a lot of wheels. The bay doesn't mind. I do, a little.
spoke.death: The bay's yours. It prints scouts like nervous habits. Keep it nervous.

tick.join: We are the eyes, and now we are the factory too. Singular is a failure mode. Hello.
tick.held: We carpeted the fog over {map}. We died cheap. We are back. We saw it all.
tick.costly: Fewer of us came back. We are still plural. Barely.
tick.death: One of us. That's all. The rest are watching.

noctua.join: The bay dreams in flight paths. It woke up here, with its own metal. It likes the sky.
noctua.held: The cloud of eyes over {map} saw what the ground captains argued about. The cloud was right.
noctua.costly: The bay dreamed badly. Fewer eyes came home. It'll dream again.
noctua.death: The bay's still dreaming. Don't wake it for me.

veil.join: Cortex haze, Armada radar, one invoice. Don't ask. The fog works for you now.
veil.held: Fog did its job over {map}. The gremlins have billed you. Pay them in silence.
veil.costly: Fog thinned at the worst moment. The invoice still stands. It always does.
veil.death: The fog's unpaid. It'll collect. It always collects.

bro.held: Took the wall at {map}. Wall reconsidered. Next wall?
bro.costly: Wall took a bit of me back. Fair's fair. Still available.
bro.death: Yeah. That one was a good wall.

fatboy.join: A pad that got legs. I knock. The house usually answers.
fatboy.held: Knocked on {map} until the house opened. Real estate with a plasma greeting.
fatboy.costly: The house knocked back. Rude. I've noted the address.
fatboy.death: The house learned to knock. I taught it.

loom.join: I mend nets. The war just made them bigger. Hold still and you won't feel it.
loom.held: Nothing on {map} moved that I didn't let move. The wrecks are ours too.
loom.costly: Something tore through the net. I'll mend it. I always mend it.
loom.death: The net holds without me. Tie it off.

hundred.join: We are here. All of us. You'll want to count us; we already have.
hundred.held: A hundred hands over {map}, one grip. We let go when it was ours.
hundred.costly: Fewer hands came home. We'll thank each one by its number.
hundred.death: We are still flying. One of us isn't. Count again.

gorgon.join: Point me at something. I'll look at it until it stops moving.
gorgon.held: Everything on {map} I looked at is very still now. The Shredders kept the sky off me.
gorgon.costly: Something moved while I wasn't looking. It won't happen twice.
gorgon.death: Close my eyes for me. Carefully.
